theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (r₀ s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), 0 < s → s < r₀ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → InjOn γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (γ α) (deriv γ α) = 0 ∧ deriv γ α ≠ 0) → ∫ x in (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s), h x ∂μHE[2] = ∫ q in Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s, q.1 * ‖deriv γ q.2‖ * h (q.1 • γ q.2)
